name: Classic leather
direction: Refine the original warm brown leather jerkin with subtle seams, a narrow belt and fitted dark boots. Stay closest to the old clothing, improve material separation and readable body detail.

name: Leather and mail
direction: Warm brown fitted leather vest over muted grey chainmail sleeves, small leather shoulder caps and worn bracers; dark trousers and boots. Sparse readable mail highlights.

name: Mercenary
direction: Dark brown riveted brigandine, modest iron guard on one shoulder, burgundy waist sash, leather gloves, charcoal trousers. Practical understated armour.

name: Traveller
direction: Layered warm brown leather jacket over dull tan cloth, wrist wraps, weathered boots and one small belt pouch. Practical rugged adventurer outfit, no cape or fur.

name: Iron and leather
direction: Brown leather chest armour with restrained dull dark steel central insert and small metal bracers, leather belt and dark trousers. Not a full plate knight; keep the compact warm silhouette.
retry_note: Original completed while retry was processing; original is the displayed option.

name: Red sash
direction: Refine the brown strapped leather outfit with a muted red short waist tabard, narrow leather belt, dark wrist guards and sturdy dark boots. Controlled contrast and deliberate pixel clusters.

name: Light soldier
direction: Fitted chocolate-brown padded jerkin, grey undersleeves, small muted iron shoulder and knee guards, warm leather belt and boots. Light practical warrior armour, not bulky.

name: Bronze fittings
direction: Dark brown leather cuirass with small tarnished bronze buckles and wrist guards, rust-brown waist cloth, charcoal trousers and brown boots. Sparse warm metallic highlights.

name: Olive gambeson
direction: Brown leather shoulder yoke over a muted olive-brown fitted quilted gambeson, narrow brown belt, dark wrist guards and sturdy boots. Subtle woven-cloth detail, restrained grounded palette.
